The '''Scabaras Dungeon''' is located underground in the [[Ruins of Ullek]] area. The dungeon plays a major role in the [[Beneath Cursed Sands]] quest. Its entrance is on the plateau, just north of the anvil and furnace, in an area surrounded by broken pillars. The Ruins of Ullek are in the south-eastern [[Kharidian Desert]] and are subject to [[desert heat]], so players are advised to bring a [[water source]]. The dungeon itself is not subject to desert heat.

Aggressive [[Scabarites]] can be found here on the 2nd level which attack with melee, ranged, and magic. They are found close together and in high numbers, making this an effective place to kill them for [[Slayer]] assignments, though the [[Sophanem Dungeon]] may be a better alternative for lower level players (maze level) and players wishing to use a [[dwarf multicannon]] (cavern level).

==Upper level==
When first entering the upper level during the quest, the player is attacked by two level 119 [[Scarab Mage|scarab mages]]. After the quest they are no longer attackable and are found guarding the [[High Priest of Scabaras]] in the westernmost room. This room is also where the player fights the [[Champion of Scabaras]] during the quest.

==Lower level==
During the quest, the bottom floor has projectiles shooting out of the [[tomb wall|tomb walls]] that damage the player if not avoided. After the quest, this area contains many [[locust rider]]s (both ranged and melee) and [[Scarab Mage|scarab mages]]. Cannons cannot be used here. The westernmost room contains a sarcophagus with [[Mehhar]] nearby.
